sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos are re-signing tight end Adam Trautman to a three-year deal. We are awaiting the contract details. The contract details are in, and it’s a three-year deal worth $17 million dollars with a max value of $18.5 million, with $9.5 million guaranteed. The Broncos are truly running […]
